coverage.definition: observed free / geometrically fully free voxels, common external mapper; truth only for scoring
coverage.ego_space: Each mapper may clear physically occupied hull from measured pose only. No ground-truth geometry sent to planners.

shared: Gazebo Harmonic quadrotor physics + lidar + noisy localization/IMU estimator + PID motor controller
adapted: Native mapping, allocation, planning and trajectory sampling retained; ROS1 transport adapter; GVP simulation clock and finite-FOV pointcloud ingress port
limitations: One paired trial cannot establish statistical superiority
ROS1/ROS2 transport and runtimes differ; record adapter delay
Internal map representation and initialization remain system-specific
A smoke failure is an integration result, never an allocation quality result
common_execution: Native trajectory sample -> identical reference governor (Euclidean speed <=0.6, acceleration <=0.8, yaw rate <=0.65) -> identical PID -> Gazebo motors. Log raw and governed references; actual tracking overshoot is measured.
self_filter: Discard returns within known physical body box [0.34,0.34,0.10] half-extents, offset [0,0,0.4]; do not raycast through discarded returns.
startup: Same bounded ascent and yaw scan for first 20 simulated seconds; exploration commands accepted from t=20.
safety_stop: physical OBB hull intersects an obstacle beyond 5mm numerical tolerance
executed reference tracking error >0.8m for >1 simulated second
mapper_adaptation: Common self-return removal; Annual and GVP clear only physical hull swept by estimated robot poses. GVP pointcloud blind range set to physical sensor minimum 0.1m.
execution_caveat: Common governor may change trajectory tracking behavior; this is an adapted full exploration closed-loop comparison, not native autopilot or allocation-only comparison. Actual speed overshoot is reported, not hidden.
comparison_to_previous: New Annual frozen flight policy; rerun all three systems. Same old map, native RACER/GVP adaptations and common reference constraints.
mapper_metadata_adaptation: Only added native integrated-frame provenance required by new Annual executor. Identical ray integration and filtering for all three systems.
prior_test: 2026-09-28 remains immutable; no old score is substituted into this trial.
